title: AFP: 101 Chinese Vessels Monitored at West Philippine Sea Features in September, Up From 56 in August
detail: AFP spokesperson Rear Adm. Roy Vincent Trinidad said 101 Chinese vessels were monitored at West Philippine Sea features in September 2026, versus 56 in August. Breakdown (China Coast Guard / PLA Navy): Ayungin Shoal 14/9, Bajo de Masinloc 25/14, Escoda Shoal 7/4, Pag-asa Islands 23/5.

media.caption: File photo accompanying GMA News report on Chinese vessel count
